title: Breast cancer diagnosis
subtitle: Classify tumours as malignant or benign from cell nucleus measurements
about: 30 measurements computed from digitized images of fine needle aspirates of breast masses. `malignant` is 1 for malignant and 0 for benign.
source: UCI Machine Learning Repository: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic), W. Wolberg, O. Mangasarian, N. Street, W. Street (1995). Distributed with scikit-learn.
